searchText: Used Brinkley 5th Wheel for sale - 2026 Brinkley Z Series Z2810 is approximately 34' 9' in length with 1 slide. Features Rear Kitchen Bath & 1/2 Residential Dishwasher Fireplace Dual Residential Recliners Pull-Out Garbage Can More About This RV Imagine your own rear gourmet kitchen with high polished solid surface countertops, a stainless steel residential dishwasher, a convection/microwave, and a residential stainless steel French door refrigerator to enjoy making meals for your spouse and your family when they visit. The lighted pantry and kitchen/bathroom toe kicks are an added luxury you will surely appreciate especially at night. The separate living area offers dual residential recliners to relax and unwind, a fireplace, and two sofas. There is a handy half bathroom for your guests only steps away, and you can enjoy your own full front bath after walking through your master bedroom with a king bed. The spacious bathroom offers a dual sink vanity, a walk-in closet, and a space to add a washer/dryer option. With any Mobile Suites fifth wheel by DRV Luxury Suites you will enjoy durable construction, beautiful interiors, and tons of storage spaces. The MORryde I.S suspension with MORryde pin box helps absorb road shock for a smooth towing experience, and the six point hydraulic leveling system will make set-up a breeze. Each model includes hassle-free conveniences, like the SeeLevel tank monitoring, the fully ducted A/C system with cold air return, solar prep, and much more! The interior is packed with luxury features, such as custom hardwood wardrobe doors, LED ceiling lights with dimmer switches, crown molding throughout, and custom hand laid glass backsplash. You may spend all your time relaxing indoors, but don't forget to check out the exterior. A power awning with LED lights, extra thick compartment doors with gas struts, and a custom painted exterior with clear coat are just a few features that are sure to be a deal breaker!
